# Epic GitLab Repository Map

Reference for finding the right repo given an Epic product domain area. Always prefer searching GitLab MCP over local clones — local repos may be stale.

> **MCP usage:** Every repo path in this skill (e.g. `appliedsystems/products/epic/user-interface/chimera-client`) can be passed directly as the `projectid` parameter to any `mcp__plugin_gitlab-mcp_gitlab__*` tool — no URL construction needed.

> **Related skill:** `epic-common:epic-domain-knowledge` covers chimera-client's internal structure (screen codes, security model, domain objects). This skill covers _where repos live in GitLab_, not what's inside them.

---

## Repo Groups at a Glance

| Group path                                               | What lives here                                                                             |
| -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `appliedsystems/products/epic/user-interface/`           | All Epic UI apps                                                                            |
| `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/chimera-server`   | Chimera backend (C#/.NET, DB access) — lives under `services/` but is its own section below |
| `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/`             | Domain miniservices (gRPC, C#/.NET)                                                         |
| `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/`                 | Background/pubsub services (everything under `services/` except chimera-server)             |
| `appliedsystems/products/epic/jobs/`                     | Async job workers                                                                           |
| `appliedsystems/products/epic/api-gateway/proxies/`      | Apigee API proxy configs                                                                    |
| `appliedsystems/products/ben/services/`                  | Benefits-specific services                                                                  |
| `appliedsystems/products/cytora/epic-autofill/services/` | CL AutoFill services                                                                        |

## Domain Miniservices

Each miniservice is a gRPC C#/.NET service handling a specific Epic program area. When a ticket touches backend logic for one of these domains, this is where the service code lives.

| Domain                          | Repo path                                                                | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Accounting / GL**             | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/modules-accounting`           | gRPC miniservice — GL accounts, transactions, vouchers, disbursements, receipts, payments, commission agreements, automated statements, reconciliation, journal entries                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Activities**                  | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/modules-activity`             | gRPC miniservice — activity records, attachments on activities, workgroups, activity rules                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Attachments**                 | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/modules-attachment`           | gRPC miniservice — attachment and file management across Epic                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Configure / Setup**           | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/modules-configure`            | gRPC miniservice — agency configuration: system/regional settings, email templates, mailboxes, screen priority, rules, locale, custom policy info                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **CRM (Clients, Contacts)**     | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/modules-crm`                  | gRPC miniservice — CRM domain: clients, contacts, companies, brokers, employees, vendors, organizations, servicing roles, relationships, accounts, payments                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Interface / Download**        | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/modules-procedures-interface` | gRPC miniservice — interface/download: DBCD suspense management and download jobs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Metadata**                    | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/modules-metadata`             | gRPC miniservice — metadata sources for document merge and report generation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Notifications**               | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/modules-notification`         | gRPC miniservice — stores and retrieves Epic Notification Center records; `ListNotifications` supports filtering by dismissed/received/suppressed state and type (job, file save/edit/transport, print, open frame, exception, general); `AddCSNotification` lets chimera-server push open-frame navigation notifications to users |
| **Opportunities**               | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/modules-opportunity`          | gRPC miniservice — opportunities and account sources                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Policy**                      | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/modules-policy`               | gRPC miniservice — policy lifecycle: policies, binders, quotes, cancellations, certificates, claims, evidence, carrier/marketing submissions, policy lines, validation rules                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Resources**                   | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/modules-resource`             | gRPC miniservice — Epic resource management (agents, staff)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Security / Permissions**      | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/modules-security`             | gRPC miniservice — users, security groups, client/org access control, report permissions                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Interface (Aspect/Download)** | `appliedsystems/products/epic/miniservices/aspect-interface`             | gRPC miniservice — Aspect/IVANS interface: communication log and translation for download workflows                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

## Background & Pub/Sub Services

| Domain                    | Repo path                                                             | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **AutoFill pub/sub**      | `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/modules-pubsub-autofill`       | Subscribes to AutoFill completion events (GCP Pub/Sub, config key `PubSubAutofillEvents`); filters to Epic-product messages via `productName` attribute; obtains IAM client credential token; sends `AddCSOpenFrameNotification` gRPC call to modules-notification with user code, Epic area, and operation metadata (operation_id, status, document_type_code) extracted from the message                                                                            |
| **Attachments pub/sub**   | `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/modules-pubsub-attachments`    | Subscribes to two GCP Pub/Sub topics and writes results to the Epic DB via `FileStorageRepository`: `PubSubProcessingComplete` (sets attachment status to OK) and document-quarantine (sets status to FAIL_VIRUS_SCAN)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Payments pub/sub**      | `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/modules-pubsub-payments`       | Go Pub/Sub service — subscribes to Applied Pay payment status events (authorized, settled, refunded, chargeback, NSF) and forwards them to the accounting miniservice                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Recon AI manager**      | `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/modules-pubsub-recon-manager`  | Go Pub/Sub orchestrator for Recon AI (Carrier Statement Automated Reconciliation) — ingests carrier statements from IVANS instant download, inbound email, direct bill, and manual upload; handlers cover carrier mapping, AI extraction (PDF/XLSX/AL3), document quarantine, reprocess-match, and reconciliation lifecycle; calls accounting, configure, interface, and document-store gRPC services; uses Redis, Postgres, and an event store                       |
| **Recon matching**        | `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/modules-recon-matching`        | Empty Go scaffold — not yet implemented (`main.go` is a Hello World stub, all source/test dirs are `.gitkeep`); planned as the data API for the matching portion of Recon AI                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Mercury**               | `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/mercury-service`               | C#/.NET gRPC service migrating Commercial Lines BM (Boiler & Machinery) data operations from chimera-server to PDC — LineDetailAPI (~70 RPCs: Premises, Statement of Values, Additional Interests, Form Endorsements, Additional Coverage, Underwriting Answers, Location Coverage), IntegrationAPI (Binder/Cancellation/PropertyLoss/Certificate), RiskAPI; routes CRUD to Epic DB or PDC API based on tenant configuration; internal-only, called by chimera-server |
| **Workflows**             | `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/workflow-server`               | .NET 8 server — executes CoreWF (Windows Workflow Foundation) XAML definitions for hundreds of Epic SMART screen codes (ACTVIEW, BINDADD, CERTISSU, CANADD, etc. in `ASI.TAM.Workflow/Accounts/`); SMART modernization compatibility layer; handles workflow start, resume, and SQL Server state persistence                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Modules bridge**        | `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/modules-bridge`                | C#/.NET bridge service for Outlook integration — OAuth auth code relay (Microsoft Graph token exchange for ui-outlook) and classic Outlook compose (attach-to-Epic, app state); calls activity, attachment, and resource miniservices                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Browser config**        | `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/modules-browser-configuration` | Go gRPC service — provides tenant login settings (always-prompt, third-party IDP) and connection suite version info for the Epic browser/Mobius workbench                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Graph middleware**      | `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/graph-middleware`              | Go service — Microsoft Graph API proxy for mail, attachments, conversations, calendar, and tasks (powers Outlook integration)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Server-sent events**    | `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/server-sent-events`            | Go SSE service — pushes real-time updates to Epic browser; consumers are Epic Connect (Outlook Add-in listener) and Recon AI                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **VINLink secret rotate** | `appliedsystems/products/epic/services/vinlink-secret-rotate`         | K8s cron job — rotates VINLink Vault secrets                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

## Job Workers

Async background job workers. Relevant when a ticket touches batch processing, report generation, or async policy/accounting/customer operations.

| Worker                   | Repo path                                                    | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Accounting**           | `appliedsystems/products/epic/jobs/worker-accounting`        | Executes accounting background jobs via Temporal (PSE type, `accounting-pse-task-queue`): GL Export, Generate Invoice, Generate Statement, Generate Journal Entries, and Reconciliation Flag All Items                                                                                 |
| **Customer**             | `appliedsystems/products/epic/jobs/worker-customer`          | Executes customer background jobs via Temporal (`customer-task-queue`); currently only `StickyNotePurgeHandler` is implemented — customer-utilities-purge (attachment/commission data purge) is registered in jobs-api but has no handler yet                                          |
| **File distribution**    | `appliedsystems/products/epic/jobs/worker-file-distribution` | Distributes files via email, network share, and printer; replaces the legacy DMS (Distribution Manager Service)                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Interface**            | `appliedsystems/products/epic/jobs/worker-interface`         | Executes IVANS API jobs exclusively via `IvansJobHandler`: CSIO broker management (create/update), mailbox notification management (create/update/delete), connection check, and password change                                                                                       |
| **Policy**               | `appliedsystems/products/epic/jobs/worker-policy`            | Empty scaffold — not yet implemented (only `HelloWorldHandler` exists; `PolicyWorkerIds.cs` has TODO comments for future jobs like applications, cancellations, and marketing submissions)                                                                                             |
| **Report generation**    | `appliedsystems/products/epic/jobs/worker-report-gen`        | Generates reports via Temporal (`report-generation-task-queue`): policy reports and certificate reports; single `PolicyReportHandler` routes both report types                                                                                                                         |
| **Jobs API** (scheduler) | `appliedsystems/products/epic/jobs/jobs-api`                 | gRPC/HTTP API — primary entry point for all job submission, status, and management; uses a YAML worker registry mapping job IDs to task queues, parameter schemas, and security requirements; routes PSE/RGS/DMS/Marketing job types to domain workers via CS Orchestrator or Temporal |

AutoFill spans multiple product teams and repos. These are the key ones beyond `ui-autofill` and `modules-pubsub-autofill` above:

| Service                      | Repo path                                                                             | Notes                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Benefits PDC writeback**   | `appliedsystems/products/ben/services/autofill-pdc-service`                           | Go/gRPC — maps dental, medical, and vision benefit data to PDC form fields via a single `PerformAutofill` RPC; called by the AutoFill platform, NOT by Epic directly      |
| **CL AutoFill service**      | `appliedsystems/products/cytora/epic-autofill/services/autofill-service`              | Go service — orchestrates CL AutoFill by connecting Cytora (AI extraction) to the AutoFill UI; manages tenant schemas, autofill operations, and Cytora file/job lifecycle |
| **CL PDC writeback**         | `appliedsystems/products/cytora/epic-autofill/services/autofill-pdc-service`          | CL variant — imports core logic from the Benefits PDC service                                                                                                             |
| **CL AutoFill Apigee proxy** | `appliedsystems/products/cytora/epic-autofill/services/autofill-service-apigee-proxy` | Apigee proxy for the CL AutoFill service — document types listing, operations listing, and Cytora webhook endpoint; JWT validation with tenant claim extraction           |

## How to Pick the Right Repo

Given an Epic ticket, use this decision tree:

1. **UI change (new button, screen, column, modal)?**
   - First check whether the domain has a dedicated React microfrontend (see UI Repos table — `ui-accounting`, `ui-crm`, `ui-policy`, `ui-configure`, etc.) — if yes, the change goes there
   - If the domain is in the chimera-client Screens list (AboutBox, AccountLocate, Accounts, Common, EmailIntegration, GeneralLedger, Home, LeadsInbox, Procedures, RenewalsManager, Report, Setup, Utilities) → `chimera-client`
   - If the domain has a dedicated React microfrontend (ui-crm, ui-accounting, ui-activity, ui-configure, ui-policy, etc.) → that repo
   - Otherwise the screen is still unmodernized legacy Chimera → `chimera-server` (C#/.NET, `DataAccess/UI/{domain}/`)
2. **Backend data access for a Chimera screen?** → `chimera-server` (look in `DataAccess/UI/{domain}/`)
3. **New domain miniservice API or business rule?** → `miniservices/modules-{domain}` (match domain from table above); note that `aspect-interface` is the exception — no `modules-` prefix
4. **Async/background job?** → `jobs/worker-{domain}`
5. **Pub/sub event (fire-and-forget after an action)?** → `services/modules-pubsub-{domain}`
6. **Public REST API endpoint (external consumers)?** → `api-gateway/proxies/{domain}`
7. **AutoFill modal / embedded platform UI?** → `user-interface/ui-autofill`
8. **AutoFill writeback (PDC/SDK)?** → `ben/services/autofill-pdc-service` or `cytora/epic-autofill/services/autofill-pdc-service`
9. **Benefits-specific backend (Benefits Overview, benefit plans, employee classes, AutoFill operations for benefits, user preferences)?** → `ben/services/ben-services` (gRPC); database schema changes → `ben/services/ben-migrations`; public REST API → `ben/services/ben-proxy`

---

## Notes

- **chimera-client permissions** (`SecureArea.ts`) must be checked via GitLab MCP — local clone may not have feature-branch additions yet.
- **AutoFill service repos** are under `products/ben/` and `products/cytora/`, not under `products/epic/` — easy to miss.
- **modules-notification** is the gRPC miniservice backing the Epic Notification Center — notification storage and retrieval with dismiss/receive/suppress state tracking, not a delivery or preferences service.
- **No `modules-marketing` or `modules-mms` exists yet** — MMS backend lives in `chimera-server` under `DataAccess/UI/Policy/Marketing/`.
- **Confirming chimera-client scope:** List `src/published/ASI.TAM/Screens/` — if no domain subfolder exists for the feature area, the screen is not yet transformed to React. The data access side always lives in chimera-server under `src/published/ASI.TAM/DataAccess/UI/{domain}/`. To check if a screen is intercepted by chimera-client React vs. served via legacy Chimera, see chimera-server's `screen-takeover.yaml` and `screen-takeover-structured.yaml`.
- **Confirming platform API client exists:** In chimera-client, list `src/core/builtins/external-api/platform/` — if no subfolder exists for the integration being built (e.g., no AutoFill client), a new platform client needs to be created as part of the work. Flag this as a gap.
